name: search_stations
description: Search radio stations by name. Returns station name, URL, country, genres, and popularity vote count. Use when looking for a specific station or browsing by keyword.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

name: get_top_stations
description: Get trending radio stations ranked by popularity, optionally filtered by country (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'DE'). Returns station URLs, genres, and vote counts.

count.description: Number of stations to return. Defaults to 10.

country.description: Filter by country name (e.g. "Germany", "United States"). Omit for global results.

name: list_countries
description: Browse available countries with radio stations. Returns country names and station counts to help target your search geographically.

name: list_tags
description: Discover radio genres and tags ranked by station count. Use to explore what categories are available before searching.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return. Defaults to 20.
